svg.font-family: Inter, 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Dijkstra, A* and CCH find the same fastest route from Tallahassee to Coral Gables
svg.desc: Three maps of the Florida road network, 1.07 million junctions. Each colors the junctions a search has to settle before it knows the fastest route from Tallahassee to Coral Gables, 8 h 18 min, all three at the same speed. Dijkstra settles 1,029,617 junctions, almost all of Florida. A* settles 840,138. The Customizable Contraction Hierarchy looks at 346, so few that it is done in the first frame. All three return the same route.
svg.text: climbs a hierarchy from both ends
Tallahassee to Coral Gables, 8 h 18 min: same route, very different work
The Florida road network, 1.07 million junctions. All three searches play at the same speed.
DIMACS USA-road FLA, fastest route by travel time. A* estimates the time left from the straight line, scaled to stay exact.
CCH counts the junctions on both climbs of its hierarchy, built once, ahead of the queries, and kept up to date as the weights change.
